_about: Public-domain Louis-Marie Grignion de Montfort (1673-1716) in English for the Word Hoard: A Treatise on the True Devotion to the Blessed Virgin, tr. Frederick William Faber (London: Burns and Lambert, 1863, second edition), and The Secret of Mary unveiled to the Devout Soul, tr. A. P. J. Cruikshank (London, 1909), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

montfort-true-devotion-faber: A Treatise on the True Devotion to the Blessed Virgin, tr. Frederick William Faber, second edition (London: Burns and Lambert, 1863)
montfort-secret-of-mary: The Secret of Mary unveiled to the Devout Soul, tr. A. P. J. Cruikshank (London: Art and Book Company, 1909)

_alternates.montfort-copies: Faber's first edition (1863; OCR garbled), twelfth edition (about 1904) and Sherbrooke 1901; The Secret of Sanctity (Boston, 1887), an abridgement; the Dublin Secret of Mary (1926)

_excluded.montfort-late: Modern Montfort Publications translations and everything from 1941 on

_pending.montfort-other: Love of Eternal Wisdom, Letter to the Friends of the Cross and Secret of the Rosary in English before 1930: not found
